title: Use ICU-parameterized l10n instead of raw 'label: value' string interpolation for chip/subtitle text
rule: AX-2 (no hardcoded user-facing strings; everything via AppLocalizations/ARB with ICU placeholders)
why: Both build a 'label: value' string by concatenating a localized label with a hardcoded ': ' separator and a raw number, rather than passing the value into an ICU-parameterized ARB string. The same feature already has the correct pattern for an almost identical 'reward cost' display (`l10n.pendingRedemptionsCost(redemption.pointsCost)` in parent_pending_redemptions_screen.dart, `l10n.achievementsMilestonePoints(...)` in achievement_tier_card.dart) -- these two sites are the odd ones out. Low practical impact (colon separators are largely locale-invariant) but genuinely inconsistent with the feature's own established i18n discipline.
recommendation: Add/reuse an ICU-parameterized ARB entry (e.g. a 'labelWithValue' string) for both sites instead of raw interpolation.
acceptance_criteria: Both sites use an AppLocalizations method with a placeholder instead of raw string interpolation for the label/value pair

corrections: First evidence entry's line should be 114, not 113 — line 113 is 'subtitle: Text(', the quoted interpolation string itself starts on 114.
